title: Document API list page
description: One page of the list response an application-managed document API (or scoped record API) gives the httpapi source provider: GET <root>?limit=N&cursor=C plus the scope and fixed query parameters. The package comment of internal/rag/providers/httpapi is the full contract; this schema is its machine-checkable part. Unknown members are allowed so an application can add its own. Item bytes are not JSON and have no schema: GET <root>/<key> returns them, with an optional ETag equal to the listed version.

items.description: The page. An empty array is a valid page.

next_cursor.description: The opaque cursor of the next page, sent back verbatim as the cursor parameter. null, absent or empty on the last page.

key.description: The item key: a clean, slash-separated relative path that the include and exclude rules are matched against. The provider additionally refuses a key with a '.' or '..' segment, a backslash, a control character or a leading slash (skipped as unsafe_name).

version.description: The item's current opaque version: the value its ETag will carry. A value of the form sha256:<64 hex digits> is a content address and is verified against the bytes.

size.description: The exact length of the item in bytes. Optional.

modified_at.description: When the item last changed (RFC 3339). Optional; with size it lets an unchanged item be skipped without fetching it.

deleted.description: True for a deletion marker: the item is gone. Optional, default false.
